Moving average is a technical analysis indicator which contributes to the decision making process when assessing the direction and strength of a trend. The Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD) is calculated by subtracting the 26-day exponential moving average (EMA) from the 12-day EMA. The current MACD value shows how far the 12-day EMA is positioned from the 26-day EMA. Fibonacci retracement is a technical analysis tool that helps to identify possible areas of support and resistance as a security's price moves. Fibonacci retracement levels are calculated by using key Fibonacci ratios (23.6%, 38.2%, 50%, 61.8%, and 100% ) to identify potential areas where a stock price may temporarily retrace its previous move before resuming its original trend. Bollinger Bands are a measure of volatility, helping traders predict price movements. Lower Bollinger Bands signify oversold conditions while upper Bollinger Bands signal overbought conditions.
